processes.action_idea: A daily job compares allocated meter volumes against active Sitara deal tickets and flags each meter with flow but no matching or unexpired deal, pre-filling the counterparty, meter, month and volume into a request to the deal owner. The deal owner still decides whether to extend, create a new deal, or sign off a write-off to unaccounted-for gas.
processes.description: Volume management, settlements or schedulers find gas flowing at a meter with no valid Sitara deal (missing, expired, wrong counterparty) and ask the deal owner to create, extend or correct the ticket, or approve a write-off to unaccounted-for gas.
processes.name: Missing or expired deal tickets for metered flow

processes.action_idea: When meter statements, actuals notices or allocation data arrive, a comparison against nominations and POPS/Sitara allocations produces a variance list by meter and day, above a tolerance. Logistics staff still investigate the flagged meters and decide on reallocation, overrides or paybacks.
processes.description: Logistics and volume management reconcile differences between nominated, metered, allocated and counterparty-reported volumes at meters, and reallocate or correct volumes before the month is finalized.
processes.name: Meter volume and allocation variance resolution

processes.action_idea: When a counterparty invoice or payment is received, its price and volume lines are matched against the Sitara deal ticket for that month and mismatches are routed to the deal owner with both values side by side. The deal owner still decides whether the deal or the invoice is wrong and confirms the correction.
processes.description: Settlements and counterparties raise price, volume or fee mismatches between invoices or payments and Sitara deal tickets; logistics verifies the deal, disputes the invoice or corrects the deal.
processes.name: Deal price and invoice discrepancy resolution

processes.action_idea: Each incoming Credit Report email is parsed into a list of counterparties and actions, then joined against open TAGG deals to produce a worklist of deal numbers to rebook or hold. Desk staff review the worklist and approve the rebooks instead of forwarding the report by hand.
processes.description: The credit group's periodic credit report lists counterparties to rebook to the correct legal entity, pending credit or do-not-confirm; it is forwarded to desk staff who apply the changes to TAGG deals.
processes.name: Credit report rebook processing

processes.action_idea: A structured request template (deal numbers, current book, target book or field change, reason, deadline, requester) is used by credit, risk and settlements staff whenever they ask for a book move or booking correction. The book administrator works from one consistent list and replies with a standard completion confirmation.
processes.description: Credit, risk, settlements and other offices ask the book administrator to move deals between trading books (including bankruptcy and Canadian books) or fix counterparty, price or book on booked deals, then confirm completion.
processes.name: Deal book transfers and booking corrections

processes.action_idea: A single book and access request template captures book name, region, trader, curve and pipe mappings, systems needed (Tagg, Sitara, TDS, EOL) and approver. Desk staff fill it in before contacting the book administrators, so requests stop bouncing back for missing details.
processes.description: Requests to create trading books, curves, portfolio and product mappings, and user access in Tagg, Sitara, TDS and EOL for traders and desks, relayed to system administrators.
processes.name: Trading book, curve and system access setup

processes.action_idea: Recurring nomination emails such as the Calpine Daily Gas Nomination are parsed on arrival into a feed of meter, gas day and volume, compared with the prior day's nomination, and only the changes are highlighted for schedulers. Schedulers still confirm the changes with the pipeline and handle cuts.
processes.description: Daily and monthly nominations and revisions from Calpine and other customers, producers and pipelines are received by email and keyed, confirmed or adjusted in the scheduling systems, including weekend on-call changes.
processes.name: Gas nomination intake and change processing

processes.action_idea: A standard outage notice template (meters affected, start and end, volume impact, nomination action, producers to notify) plus a ready-made producer shut-in letter is used by logistics staff whenever gas control announces maintenance or a shut-in.
processes.description: Notices of pipeline maintenance, cuts, leaks and meter shut-ins are relayed to schedulers and producers so nominations at the affected meters are halted, made up and resumed.
processes.name: Pipeline outage and shut-in notice handling

processes.action_idea: Incoming CAISO notices are parsed into a desk feed tagged by type (derate, outage, procedure update, settlement) with affected paths and hours, replacing manual forwarding. Traders still decide how to adjust hour-ahead and day-ahead schedules.
processes.description: CAISO operating, derate, settlement and market design notices are read and forwarded to the real-time desk so traders adjust schedules and bids.
processes.name: CAISO market notice relay to the real-time desk

processes.action_idea: A standing procedures checklist for the real-time shift (deal entry in Enpower and CAPS, cuts, lending, tags) and a fixed position notice template (hub, hours, MW, price, book, deal number) are used by the desk lead, so each email follows the same structure and rules are not re-explained.
processes.description: The real-time desk lead emails shift traders the hourly long and short positions to cover and standing rules for entering deals, cuts, lending and schedules in Enpower and CAPS.
processes.name: Real-time desk position and procedure instructions

processes.action_idea: After CAISO publishes awards each day, a comparison of awarded congestion volumes and prices against the inc sheet and submitted bids computes expected revenue and flags mismatches. A trader still reviews flagged awards and decides which to dispute before settlements books the revenue.
processes.description: The real-time desk tracks CAISO congestion awards, calculates the revenue against the inc sheet and Enron bids, and tells settlements to book it or dispute mispriced awards.
processes.name: CAISO congestion revenue reconciliation

processes.action_idea: An end-of-shift comparison of Enpower deals against CAPS schedules and position manager lists every hour and book that is not flat or has a missing deal. The shift trader still decides the correction and enters it.
processes.description: Real-time staff find mismatches between Enpower, CAPS, position manager, schedule sheets and EPE schedules, then correct deals, annuities and prior month adjustments with deal control and settlements.
processes.name: Real-time deal entry and position variance reconciliation

processes.action_idea: A weekly scheduled job pulls the delivery, utilization and Gas Daily price figures and generates the California Capacity Report in the existing format for distribution. An analyst only reviews the draft and adds commentary before it is sent.
processes.description: Commercial staff compile and email a weekly report of Transwestern and El Paso California deliveries, utilization and posted Gas Daily prices.
processes.name: Weekly California Capacity Report

processes.action_idea: A monthly job builds the imbalance summary per OBA and interconnect from scheduled and measured volumes and attaches the supporting statements for each counterparty. Staff still negotiate whether to cash out or pay back and agree the schedule.
processes.description: Logistics and commercial staff distribute OBA and pipeline imbalance summaries, reconcile scheduled versus measured volumes with interconnect counterparties, and agree cash-out or payback.
processes.name: Pipeline and OBA imbalance reconciliation

processes.action_idea: A contract change request template (contract number, shipper, change type, quantity or points, effective dates, commercial approval) is used by the commercial rep when forwarding a customer request to contract administration, so amendments can be drafted without follow-up questions.
processes.description: Customer requests to change transport contracts (MDQ, receipt points, name changes) are approved by the commercial rep and relayed to contract administration to draft amendments.
processes.name: Transport contract amendment requests

processes.action_idea: A pre-filled survey checklist carrying last month's activity counts and hours, plus a reminder schedule up to the deadline, is used by desk managers so they only update what changed and return the survey on time.
processes.description: Staff complete recurring monthly activity driver and OPM hours surveys for cost allocation, with reminders and clarification questions until the deadline.
processes.name: Monthly activity and hours surveys

processes.action_idea: A daily and month-end close checklist (officialize books, approve DPR, send post ids, top-level adjustments, origination reconciliation, flash) with cutoff times is used by the book administrators, along with a standard DPR distribution email.
processes.description: Desk staff produce, approve and distribute daily P&L and position reports (DPR), officialize books, send post ids, and support month-end flash, origination and P&L adjustments.
processes.name: Daily P&L, position report and book close

processes.action_idea: A request intake template (requester, counterparty or curve, as-of date, documents needed, due date) plus ready-made replies for recurring auditor P&L and MTM requests is used by the desk's mid-office contact, who tracks each request to delivery.
processes.description: Auditors, risk and credit ask the desk for deal tickets, monthly P&L top pages, MTM values by counterparty, and explanations of curve changes, which must be gathered from desk staff.
processes.name: Audit, valuation and curve validation data requests
